description: Canonical provider-neutral Spec-Driven Development workflow: ten ordered phases, three modes, blocking gates and artifact contracts. Methodology only; it does not install or execute any external toolkit.

phases.objective: Record the project principles and non-negotiable constraints that every later artifact must respect.
State what is needed and why as testable requirements with acceptance criteria, without choosing a technology.
Resolve every open question in the requirements before planning.
Choose the technical approach and record each decision with its rationale and the requirements it serves.
Check requirement quality and testability before tasks are cut.
Break the plan into owned tasks, each linked to requirements and acceptance criteria, with explicit paths.
Read-only consistency analysis across requirements, decisions, tasks and scope before any change is made.
Execute approved tasks by an implementer, inside the declared scope only.
Reconcile the implementation with the requirements, decisions and tasks and close any drift.
A validator that implemented nothing verifies every acceptance criterion and records evidence. Local final gate.

modes.selection: New products, new capabilities, cross-cutting or high-risk work, anything touching data models, security or multiple components, or work whose requirements are not yet understood.
Well-understood, bounded changes in an existing project that already has a constitution and an established approach, with a small number of tasks.
Urgent, narrowly scoped correction of a defect in existing behavior. Never for migrations, production schema changes or new capabilities. Urgency never waives approval or independent validation.

gates.blocks: The implement phase and any file change.
Any database or data migration, including its authoring in a runnable form.
Any change to production data, production schema or production configuration.
